notes: Named in [0031] as the compound whose preparation is improved by using cheap 氢溴酸 as the brominating agent. The sentence says 提高了收率 (raised the yield) but prints no figure, so yield_pct stays null. is_section_product is false because the section is headed by 有益效果 and not by a compound. commercially_available is false because step 1) of this patent prepares it.

Named in [0031] as 价格便宜的氢溴酸为溴化剂, the cheap brominating agent this process uses. role is reagent because the text names it 溴化剂 (brominating agent). Advantage 1 names no reagent that 氢溴酸 replaces, so no counterpart record is emitted for it. No hazard tag: the patent warns about no hazard here and instead says the change 降低了安全风险 (lowers the safety risk). Bulk commodity reagent that no step of this patent prepares, so commercially_available is true.

notes: Named in [0032] as the compound whose preparation uses market-available 2,2,2-三氟乙醇 as the raw material. The English identifier keeps the locant order the Chinese prints. is_section_product is false because the section is headed by 有益效果. commercially_available is false because step 2) of this patent prepares it.

Named in [0032] as 在市场上易得的2,2,2-三氟乙醇为原料. role is reactant because the text names it 原料 (raw material). commercially_available is true because the text itself says it is readily obtainable on the market. Advantage 2 names no material that it replaces, so no counterpart record is emitted.

Named in [0033] as 环磺酮的合成, the synthesis this advantage is about. 环磺酮 is the standard Chinese common name for tembotrione, so the resolution is unambiguous and the EN line agrees. is_section_product is false because the section is headed by 有益效果 and names no product of its own. commercially_available is false because step 3) of this patent prepares it.

Printed in [0033] as the Latin-letter abbreviation DMF and kept in the form the text uses. The sentence 使用DMF代替乙腈 states only that DMF replaces 乙腈 in the tembotrione synthesis and never names DMF's function, and the document uses DMF in two different functions elsewhere, as a step 2) solvent option and as the step 3) catalyst, so role stays other and compound_class is skipped rather than guessed. No hazard tag: [0033] calls DMF the 低毒 (low-toxicity) half of the pair. Bulk commodity chemical that no step of this patent prepares, so commercially_available is true.

Named in [0033] as the chemical DMF replaces, and the same sentence calls the replaced half 高毒化学品 (high-toxicity chemical), which is what hazard:toxic records. role is solvent because 乙腈 is named as a 溶剂 everywhere else in this document and never in any other function. Two internal inconsistencies are recorded rather than fixed: [0033] presents 乙腈 as replaced, while [0024] still lists it as an acceptable step 2) solvent for this invention; and [0009] calls 乙腈 中等毒性 (moderate toxicity) where [0033] calls the replaced chemical 高毒 (high toxicity). Bulk commodity solvent that no step of this patent prepares, so commercially_available is true.

Named in [0034] as the 原料 this process does not use, because it is 易燃、易爆、易潮解 (flammable, explosive, readily deliquescent). hazard:flammable and hazard:explosive come from that sentence; 易潮解 (deliquescent) has no value in the hazard tag set and is recorded here only. role is reactant because the text names it 原料. Advantage 4 names no compound that takes its place. Bulk commodity reagent that no step of this patent prepares, so commercially_available is true.
